# Kamakshi Cinema Photography

> Wedding photography and cinematography studio in Andhra Pradesh, India — RAW photo capture, LOG/10-bit video, true 4K delivery, in-house editing and double data backup on every event.

## Docs

- [Home](https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/): Studio overview — why clients choose Kamakshi, recent wedding films, featured gallery, booking videos and studio location map.
- [Wedding Films](https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/films): Recent wedding films and cinematography work — every film shot, edited and colour graded in-house.
- [Gallery](https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/gallery): Full frame gallery from the studio feed — wedding, pre-wedding, candid and traditional photography from recent events.

## Services

- Wedding Photography (https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/): Full-day wedding coverage with RAW photo capture and in-house editing.
- Cinematography (https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/films): LOG and 10-bit video capture, true 4K delivery, in-house colour grading.
- Candid Photography (https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/gallery): Unposed, documentary-style coverage of weddings and pre-wedding events.
- Aerial Drone Coverage (https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/): Licensed aerial coverage of venues and events.
- Live Streaming (https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/): Live stream of wedding events for remote family and friends.
- Online Delivery (https://kamakshicinemaphotography.com/): One online drive link to view, download and share the final gallery; every event's data is double backed up.
